# KH DIESEL FUEL PUMP SDN BHD

## Services
- [Diesel fuel pump repair](https://autoseo.my/preview/kh-diesel/diesel-fuel-pump-repair-bintulu/): Inline and rotary pumps tested and set on the bench.
- [Common rail pump repair](https://autoseo.my/preview/kh-diesel/common-rail-pump-repair-bintulu/): High-pressure pumps for modern diesels.
- [Injector repair and testing](https://autoseo.my/preview/kh-diesel/injector-repair-bintulu/): Common-rail and diesel injectors tested, cleaned and set.
- [Turbo repair](https://autoseo.my/preview/kh-diesel/turbo-repair-bintulu/): Turbochargers stripped, rebuilt and checked.
- [Fuel system diagnosis](https://autoseo.my/preview/kh-diesel/fuel-system-diagnosis-bintulu/): Find out whether it is the pump, the injectors or the turbo.
